title: Important legal dates, practical blocks and deadlines
text: Important dates पहले. Fresh recruit order, 23 September 2008; fresh FAQs, 26 September 2014. HQ और NCR clarification, 18 May 2015. Current official FAQ, 1 July 2025; consolidation, 3 September 2025. Ye issue dates हैं, सब benefits की new start dates नहीं. Aaj 27 October 2026: regular block 2026 to 2029; Home Town sub-blocks 2026 to 2027 और 2028 to 2029. Previous eligible LTC carry का outward deadline, 31 December 2026; All India पर extra condition है. Fresh recruit: one year service के बाद calendar slots, unused slot पर zero grace. Sir, exact rule के बाद simple explanation और तुरंत example दीजिए; five tables भी cover कीजिए.
roman_text: Important dates pehle. Fresh recruit order, 23 September 2008; fresh FAQs, 26 September 2014. HQ aur NCR clarification, 18 May 2015. Current official FAQ, 1 July 2025; consolidation, 3 September 2025. Ye issue dates hain, sab benefits ki new start dates nahi. Aaj 27 October 2026: regular block 2026 to 2029; Home Town sub-blocks 2026 to 2027 aur 2028 to 2029. Previous eligible LTC carry ka outward deadline, 31 December 2026; All India par extra condition hai. Fresh recruit: one year service ke baad calendar slots, unused slot par zero grace. Sir, exact rule ke baad simple explanation aur turant example dijiye; five tables bhi cover kijiye.

title: Rule 8: frequency, normal choices and annual option

units.explanation: Normal Home Town: two calendar years के block में one occasion.
units.example: Ravi ने 2026 में ली; same 2026–27 block में repeat नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule eight a; FAQs nineteen, seventy.
units.explanation: Distance छोटा हो सकता है; HQ और Home Town अलग places हों.
units.example: Neha का Home Town nearby है; distance alone से reject नहीं.

units.explanation: All India: four calendar years में one occasion, distance चाहे जितना हो; India के अंदर.
units.example: Ravi 2026 में Goa गया; 2028 का second All India नहीं.

units.explanation: All India extra third occasion नहीं; one Home Town को replace करता है.
units.example: Neha: 2026–27 All India ली; उसी slot की extra Home Town नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule eight a and b, normal choice.
units.explanation: Two Home Town भी allowed; All India लेना compulsory नहीं.
units.example: Ravi: 2026–27 और 2028–29, दोनों में Home Town choose करता है.

units.spoken_ref: Rule eight b, proviso, journey date.
units.explanation: Outward date पर Home Town slot available हो; future slot advance नहीं.
units.example: Neha ने 2026–27 Home Town use की; 2027 में उसी slot पर All India नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule eight, clause c, family location.
units.explanation: Family Home Town पर away रहती है? Self-only annual option देखो.
units.example: Delhi-posted Ravi की family Jaipur में; खुद yearly visit option लेता है.

Normal scheme choose ki, toh us four-year block mein fresh pattern nahi. Example, Neha normal option leti hai; same block mein extra fresh annual slot nahi. FAQ sixty seven, no carry. Eighth All India unused thi? Following sub-block mein Home Town ya All India choice. Example, Ravi 2023 eighth skip karta hai; 2024–25 mein All India choose kar sakta hai.
